newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka Jan-June 97 trade gap rises to $886 mln.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka Jan-June 97 trade gap rises to $886 mln.

text.p: Sri Lanka's trade balance in the first six months of this year rose sharply by 27.6 percent in dollar terms to $886 million from $694 million in the same period last year, the Central Bank said on Monday.
Exports rose 12.3 percent to $2.04 billion during the period, from $1.81 billion in the year-ago period.
Imports were up 16.5 percent to $2.93 billion from $2.51 billion in the year-ago period, the bank said in its latest economic report.

Industrial exports increased by 14.3 percent to $1.512 billion from $1.324 billion in the same period last year, pushed up mainly by a 18.6 percent rise in textile and apparel exports, which account for around 65 percent of Sri Lanka's industrial exports.
